question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 12,500 at 3% per annum for 3 years when interest is compounded annually (correct to the nearest rupees).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The net effective rate for **3%** for **3 years** is calculated as: 3 + 3 + 3 + (3×3 + 3×3 + 3×3)/100 + (3×3×3)/10000 = 9.2727%.

**Compound Interest** = Principal × Net Effective Rate

⇒ CI = 12,500 × 9.2727% = 125 × 9.2727 = 1159.0875

Rounding to the nearest rupee, we get ₹1,159.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,159.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹12,500

**Rate (R)** = 3% per annum

**Time (T)** = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)T

Compound Interest (CI) = A − P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46f53e22d88b2a865d7431170b32e1018a71443254f949180eda2597f929ef25.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ A = 12,500 × (1 + 3/100)³

⇒ A = 12,500 × (1.03)³

⇒ A = 12,500 × (1.03 × 1.03 × 1.03)

⇒ A = 12,500 × 1.092727

⇒ A = 13,659.0875

⇒ CI = A − P

⇒ CI = 13,659.0875 − 12,500

⇒ CI = 1,159.0875

⇒ CI ≈ ₹1,159 (Correct to the nearest rupee)

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,159.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Properties

In **Compound Interest**, the interest from the previous year is added to the principal to calculate the interest for the next period, leading to exponential growth.

Difference between CI and SI

For 2 years: CI − SI = P(R/100)². For 3 years: CI − SI = P(R/100)² × (3 + R/100).

Effective Rate of Interest

The effective rate for 3 years can be found using the successive percentage change formula: a + b + (ab/100) applied twice.
